description: A grant on an AWS KMS key, made with KMS's CreateGrant. It lets a principal use the key in the operations it lists. AWS has no call that changes a grant, so every property is create-only. Deleting it retires it.

EncryptionContextEquals.description: The grant allows a cryptographic operation only when the request's encryption context is exactly these pairs.

EncryptionContextSubset.description: The grant allows a cryptographic operation only when the request's encryption context includes these pairs.

SourceArn.description: The grant allows its operations only when the request is made on behalf of the AWS resource with this ARN.

KeyId.description: The key ID or key ARN of the KMS key. Use the key ARN for a key in another AWS account. AWS reports the key ARN.

GranteePrincipal.description: The ARN of the AWS principal that gets the grant's permissions. Set this or GranteeServicePrincipal, not both.

GranteeServicePrincipal.description: The AWS service principal that gets the grant's permissions, such as rds.amazonaws.com. It needs Constraints.SourceArn and a retiring principal.

RetiringPrincipal.description: The ARN of the AWS principal that can retire the grant. Set this or RetiringServicePrincipal, not both.

RetiringServicePrincipal.description: The AWS service principal that can retire the grant.

Operations.description: The operations the grant allows. The key must support each one.

Constraints.description: Conditions on the requests the grant allows.

Name.description: The name Radius gives the grant, from the create's client token. AWS returns the existing grant for a create with the same name and values, so a create Radius sends again never makes a second grant.

GrantId.description: The ID AWS gives the grant.

IssuingAccount.description: The AWS account that created the grant, as the ARN of its root user.
